cases.issue_summary: Premium total does not match the source record
cases.issue_description: The written premium total in the downstream policy reporting data does not reconcile to the source transaction total. Review the linked policies and compare transaction-level premium values across processing layers.

cases.issue_summary: Coverage data is missing from the Gold policy record
cases.issue_description: Coverage information expected for this policy was not found in the reporting record. Confirm whether the coverage exists upstream and identify where it stopped appearing.

cases.issue_summary: Policy status does not match its latest transaction
cases.issue_description: The current policy status appears inconsistent with its latest recorded transaction. Verify transaction ordering, effective dates, and the status derivation rule.

cases.issue_summary: Duplicate policy transaction found in the reporting layer
cases.issue_description: More than one reporting row appears to represent the same policy transaction. Compare source transaction identifiers and revision numbers to investigate.

cases.issue_summary: Source policy data did not arrive in the expected batch
cases.issue_description: The expected source records were not present in the batch under review. Check batch arrival and ingestion status, then confirm the affected policies with the source owner.

cases.issue_summary: ADF pipeline failed before the policy batch completed
cases.issue_description: The data pipeline reported a failure before the policy batch completed. Review the failed activity, available run details, and batch checkpoint.

cases.issue_summary: Informatica mapping omitted a required policy field
cases.issue_description: A required policy field is absent after the Informatica mapping step. Compare the source field, mapping expression, and target column.

cases.issue_summary: Policy record is missing after the downstream load
cases.issue_description: The policy is present before the downstream load but is not visible in the reporting output. Compare business keys and check load filters and join conditions.
